statement: For the scalar FixedBook mathematical shadow: successful positive-total largest-remainder allocation conserves its target and bounds every fill; the max-volume/min-imbalance/highest-index rule has a unique winner on every nonempty bounded grid; accepted buy and sell folds both equal matched and partition the fill sum; canonical zero padding does not change the active-prefix fold.

mutations.edit: one selected entry receives two atoms instead of one
the scan tests the previous winner against the challenger but still selects the challenger
each side fold includes entries from both sides
canonical padding admits nonnegative rather than zero suffixes

known_unclosed_boundaries: the production Rust body is digest-pinned and manually mapped, not imported into Verus
the dust loop's existence/progress and distinct positive-remainder selection are theorem premises, not proved from the quotient phase
unbounded mathematical integers are mapped manually to checked u64 totals and widened u128 products
score construction and the production choose_tick loop are not refined instruction-by-instruction
inactive scalar Order fields other than canonical_order_id are not required to be zero by production validation
relation_v1, relation_v1_stream, pairing, portfolio, AON, Solana/SBF, serialization, accounts, and deployment are excluded
